sources.title: GitHub - QwenLM/Qwen-Image-2.1: Qwen's most powerful open-source image ...
sources.snippet: We are excited to open-source Qwen-Image-2.1, a unified text-to-image generation and image editing model in the Qwen family. With just 7B parameters in its visual generation component (32 Single-Stream DiT layers), Qwen-Image-2.1 balances generation quality, inference efficiency, and versatility. Four key improvements define this release: Compact and Efficient — A lightweight architecture ...

sources.title: Alibaba's Qwen-Image-2.1 Now Runs on Apple Silicon at Just 7 GB ...
sources.snippet: JoyFusionAI released a 4-bit MLX build of Qwen-Image-2.1 for Apple Silicon via mflux. Peak memory drops to about 7 GB on M1 Max at 768x768 with the low-ram flag. Roughly 6.7 seconds per step, 40 steps recommended, no classifier-free guidance needed. Upstream model unifies text-to-image, editing, and native RGBA transparency in one 7B DiT.

sources.title: GitHub - The-Focus-AI/qwen-image-2.1-mlx: Local Qwen-Image-2.1 text-to ...
sources.snippet: Local text-to-image for Qwen-Image-2.1 on a Mac, using mflux and MLX. The model runs on the Metal GPU. The CUDA ComfyUI installer at alesha-pro/tools is for an NVIDIA GPU. It is pinned to a CUDA PyTorch wheel and does not run on this machine. This repo is the Apple Silicon path: mflux 0.20.0 at commit ada53237, which added mflux-generate-qwen-2.1.
